propositions: Production rich-text convergence mutates binding entries through shallow all_bindings() query, bypassing lifecycle policy controls, requiring a named mutation seam.
The new note_rich_emit operation must produce identical hash, counter, and persisted bytes as the legacy mutation sequence without introducing per-emit saves or dirty-gating.
Missing bindings must remain nonfatal and distinguishable, returning a distinct result rather than a numeric counter.
The operation must not expose direct repository or lifecycle mutation access to production adapters or reconciler callers.
all_bindings() must retain shallow copy semantics and all existing facade signatures must remain unchanged.
